title: The MODNAP benchmark set for modeling ribose-based modified nucleic acid and nucleic acid-protein complexes: a case study with AlphaFold 3.
authors: Fu, Jiemin; Milam, Valeria Tohver; McShan, Andrew C
one_liner_zh: 该文构建了含修饰核糖核苷酸的核酸及核酸-蛋白复合物结构数据集MODNAP，并系统评估AlphaFold 3的预测性能，虽对象为核酸而非蛋白质，但其结构预测基准测试方法可迁移至蛋白质体系，对蛋白质结构计算有参考价值。
abstract: Modified nucleic acids play important roles in biology and biotechnology. However, their chemical and structural diversity as well as effects on nucleic acid structure and intermolecular interactions remain incompletely characterized. The performance of structure prediction and co-folding algorithms for modeling modified nucleic acids and nucleic acid-protein complexes has also not been evaluated. Here, we systematically analyze ribose-based modified nucleotides present in structures deposited in the Protein Data Bank. Modified nucleotides are primarily localized to the nucleobase, where they exhibit chemical and structural diversity shaped by molecular size, topological shape descriptors, and polarity-related properties. We develop MODNAP, the first curated dataset of experimentally determined structures containing modified nucleotides. Using MODNAP, we benchmark AlphaFold 3 on 1039 nucleic acid and nucleic acid-protein complex structures spanning a range of nucleotide modifications, tertiary folds, and biological functions. AlphaFold 3 achieves success rates exceeding 80% at an RMSD threshold of 2.5 A. However, its accuracy in positioning modified nucleotides is variable and decreases for structures not explicitly represented in training. PoseBusters analysis reveals frequent intramolecular validity failures, primarily due to non-ideal ribose ring geometries. Together, these results establish MODNAP as a resource for evaluating and improving structure prediction methods for modified nucleic acids.
abstract_zh: 修饰核酸在生物学和生物技术中扮演重要角色。然而，其化学和结构多样性以及对核酸结构和分子间相互作用的影响仍未得到充分表征。用于建模修饰核酸及核酸-蛋白质复合物的结构预测和共折叠算法的性能也尚未被评估。在此，我们系统分析了蛋白质数据银行（Protein Data Bank）中沉积结构中的核糖基修饰核苷酸。修饰核苷酸主要定位于核碱基，其化学和结构多样性受分子大小、拓扑形状描述符和极性相关性质的影响。我们开发了MODNAP，这是首个包含修饰核苷酸实验确定结构的精选数据集。利用MODNAP，我们对AlphaFold 3在1039个核酸及核酸-蛋白质复合物结构上进行了基准测试，这些结构涵盖多种核苷酸修饰、三级折叠和生物学功能。在RMSD阈值为2.5 Å时，AlphaFold 3的成功率超过80%。然而，其在定位修饰核苷酸方面的准确性存在变异性，并且对于训练中未明确表示的结构，准确性有所下降。PoseBusters分析揭示了频繁的分子内有效性失败，主要归因于非理想的核糖环几何结构。综合这些结果，MODNAP被确立为评估和改进修饰核酸结构预测方法的资源。
